Cybersecurity work

My strongest project is a phishing URL risk analyzer I built and deployed on my own, followed by what I’m studying next.

featured project, individual, live deployment

PhishShield

Phishing links look harmless until you inspect them. PhishShield takes one URL and gathers the signals behind it (the address itself, the domain’s history, its certificate and its reputation) into a single phishing-risk assessment.

  • Python
  • Flask
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • VirusTotal
  • WHOIS
  • SSL
Live demo Source code

It is a learning project. Its risk assessments have not been independently validated, so treat them as a guide, not a verdict.

analysis workflowillustrative, not the live app’s interface
https://secure-login.example/verify?id=1
  • URL length and special characters
  • Suspicious keywords
  • HTTPS status and redirects
  • IP and domain information
  • Domain age
  • Blacklist indicators
  • VirusTotal integration
  • WHOIS lookup
  • SSL certificate analysis
